<div class="card-body">
'''R5-M2 (Arfive-Emmtoo)''' is a [[Light]] [[Character]] ([[Droid]]) from [[Hoth (Japanese)|Hoth (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">R5-M2 (アーファイブ・エムトゥ)</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">搭乗する大型艦の戦闘力と航行速度に1を加える。加えてその大型艦は耐：損耗＜3を得る。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Hoth-R5-M2-Arfive-Emmtoo-PSA-89232341.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">亜光速での戦術的な航路を算出するようにプログラムされている。R5ユニットは戦闘用宇宙船に広く使用されており、R5-M2はエコー基地からの脱出ルートを立案する際に活躍した。所有者はショーン・ヴァルデス。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' R5-M2 (Arfive-Emmtoo).

'''Card text:'''
Adds 1 to power and hyperspeed of a capital starship it is aboard. That capital starship also gains immunity to attrition less than 3.

'''Lore:'''
Programmed to calculate sublight tactical courses. R5 units are widely used on combat starships. R5-M2 helped plan Echo Base evacuation routes. Owned by Shawn Valdez.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' Printed parenthetical is アーファイブ・エムトゥ, not Emmtoo.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[R5-M2 (Arfive-Emmtoo)]] in [[Hoth (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 43, 103. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
